dct_description_sm: This polygon shapefile depicts boundaries of subdivisions over which the County of Sacramento, California holds authority.The County Subdivision Review Committee takes final action on Parcel maps (4 Parcels or less) that do not require hearings at the Community Planning Commission or the County Planning Commission. Their actions can be appealed to the County Planning Commission. This layer is part of a collection of data originally produced for Sacramento County, California.

The Sacramento County Geographic Information Systems (GIS) unit falls under the purview of the Sacramento County Department of Technology and is tasked with initiating, integrating and promoting the use of GIS Technology in the support of County business goals and objectives. This coverage can be used for basic applications, such as viewing, querying and map output production, or to provide a base map to support graphical overlays and analyses of geospatial data.
